# Password365 (also written Password 365)

> Password365 is an open-source password manager with no cloud and no account. Passwords, passkeys and one-time codes (TOTP) stay encrypted on the user's own devices, which sync directly with each other on the same network. Free on Mac, Windows, Linux and as a Chrome, Edge and Firefox extension. iPhone and iPad coming soon; Android in development. Not independently audited yet; code is GPL-3.0.

- [Password365 vs KeePassXC](https://password365.app/keepassxc-alternative/): two ways to keep passwords off the cloud.
- [Import from 1Password, Bitwarden, Chrome and more](https://password365.app/import-passwords/)
- [How Password365 syncs without a server](https://password365.app/how-sync-works/)
- [Passkeys and one-time codes](https://password365.app/passkeys-and-one-time-codes/)
